title: 第13章 成为计划最高负责人第14章 给异世界录像
slug: 魔法我钢铁洪流直接平推
lines: “谁啊？”林默打开门，是赵刚。
只见赵刚脸上露出一丝温和笑意，主动伸出手，
“林默同志，怎么样，这里还住得习惯么？”
被叫同志，林默有些受精，连忙伸出手握住。
“谢谢领导安排，这里我很喜欢。”
“嗯，喜欢就好，有什么需要的随时和我们说。”赵刚进屋，指了指沙发，
“你先坐，不用紧张。”
林默客套：“还是领导你先吧。”
赵刚：“没事，你先。”
林默：“这哪行啊，你坐吧。”
林默也不好一直跟他大眼瞪小眼，只好硬着头皮，坐了下来。
赵刚见状这才落座。
屋里的气氛有一瞬间的凝固。
“我知道，你现在脑子肯定很乱。”赵刚先开了口，
“身份的转变，环境的变化，还有对未来的迷茫。”
林默怔了一下，紧绷的身体下意识松弛了些，点了点头，
“确实有点......反应不过来。”
“这是正常的。”赵刚微微一笑，
“任何一个普通人，突然被告知自己肩负着一个文明的未来，都会感到迷茫。”
他直视着林默的眼睛，认真道：
“但事实是，你带回来的东西，已经通过了国家最高科学院的验证。”
“你，林默，就是我们文明在末日中，抓住的唯一一缕希望之光。”
“所以，祖国需要你......人类文明需要你！”
林默沉默了。
他脑子里乱七八糟的想法，什么升职加薪、走上人生巅峰之类的念头，突然就被这句话给冲刷得一干二净。
一种沉甸甸的，几乎要把他压垮的感觉涌了上来。
那是一种被需要的责任感。
他抬起头，目光变得认真，
“我该怎么做？”
赵刚的脸上，终于露出了一丝近似于欣慰的表情。
他要的，不是一个被动接受命令的棋子。
他要的，是一个能主动扛起整个文明的战士。
“为了配合你的行动，高层已经通过决议。”
content_en:
"Who is it?" Lin Mo opened the door and it was Zhao Gang.
I saw a gentle smile on Zhao Gang's face, and he reached out his hand.
"Comrade Lin Mo, how are you? Are you still getting used to living here?"
Being called comrade, Lin Mo felt a little overwhelmed and quickly stretched out his hand to hold it.
"Thank you for the arrangement. I like it here very much."
"Well, as long as you like it, let us know if you need anything." Zhao Gang entered the room and pointed to the sofa.
"You sit down first, don't be nervous."
Lin Mo politely said: "I'd better lead you first."
Zhao Gang: "It's okay, you go first."
Lin Mo: "How can this be done? Just sit down."
Lin Mo couldn't keep staring at him, so he had to bite the bullet and sit down.
Zhao Gang took his seat after seeing this.
The atmosphere in the room froze for a moment.
"I know, your mind must be very confused now." Zhao Gang spoke first,
"Changes in identity, changes in environment, and confusion about the future."
Lin Mo was startled for a moment. His tense body subconsciously relaxed a little, and he nodded.
"It's really... hard to react."
"This is normal." Zhao Gang smiled slightly.
"Any ordinary person who is suddenly told that he is responsible for the future of civilization will feel confused."
He looked directly into Lin Mo's eyes and said seriously:
"But the fact is that what you brought back has been verified by the country's highest academy of sciences."
"You, Lin Mo, are the only ray of hope that our civilization holds on to in the apocalypse."
"So, the motherland needs you... human civilization needs you!"
Lin Mo was silent.
The messy thoughts in his mind, such as promotion and salary increase, and reaching the peak of life, were suddenly washed away by these words.
A heavy, almost crushing feeling came over him.
It is a sense of responsibility that is needed.
He raised his head, his eyes became serious,
"What should I do?"
Zhao Gang's face finally showed an expression that was close to relief.
What he wants is not a chess piece that passively accepts orders.
What he wants is a warrior who can take the initiative to carry the entire civilization.
"In order to cooperate with your actions, the top management has passed a resolution."
